name: TTS Evaluation Harness
short_description: Reusable evaluation harness for TTS systems measuring speaker similarity (GE2E cosine), TTFB, RTF, WER, and duration ratio across multiple prompt sets.

entry_points.name: run_eval
entry_points.description: CLI entry point: run synthesis + timing across any combination of 8 TTS systems and 2 prompt sets, saving per-clip metrics JSON.

entry_points.name: score_speaker_sim
entry_points.description: CLI entry point: compute GE2E speaker similarity and WER on synthesized audio, updating per-clip metrics JSON in place.

entry_points.name: report
entry_points.description: CLI entry point: aggregate per-clip metrics into metrics.json (variant format), tables.json, and three charts.

entry_points.name: elevenlabs_david
entry_points.description: Synthesize text via ElevenLabs streaming API, measuring TTFB from first non-empty chunk.

entry_points.name: kokoro_george
entry_points.description: Synthesize via Kokoro-82M base model with bm_george voice through build_pipeline.

entry_points.name: kokoro_v3_bundle
entry_points.description: Synthesize via Kokoro-82M with fine-tuned v3 decoder + David voicepack.

entry_points.name: load_kokoro_model_with_checkpoint
entry_points.description: Load KModel (stock or with a five-module packaged checkpoint) ready for build_pipeline.

entry_points.name: build_centroid
entry_points.description: Compute L2-normalized mean GE2E embedding from a list of reference WAV files.

entry_points.name: compute_speaker_sim
entry_points.description: Score synthesized audio against a reference centroid or half-B embeddings using GE2E cosine similarity.

entry_points.name: compute_wer
entry_points.description: Transcribe synthesized audio with Whisper base.en and compute WER vs reference text.

entry_points.name: compute_duration_ratio
entry_points.description: Compute per-clip synthesis/reference duration ratio; flag clips with ratio > 5.0 as explosions.

entry_points.name: extract
entry_points.description: Extract five-module state dict from a raw StyleTTS2/Kokoro training checkpoint.

entry_points.name: build_reference_split
entry_points.description: Split ElevenLabs reference corpus 679/679 (seed=42), compute centroid from half-A, return (centroid, half_b_paths).
